rewrites.comment: Case-study shells are written to /projects/<slug>/index.html at build time. This must sit AFTER the exact /projects rule above and BEFORE the catch-all, otherwise a project URL falls through to /index.html and serves the homepage's <head> — wrong title, wrong canonical, wrong OG card.
